items.question: What is Suvarna Vridhhi Yojna?
items.answer: It is a disciplined gold savings scheme at Pradeep Jewellers: you pay a fixed monthly installment for your chosen tenure. When you complete all payments on time, you receive back your total paid EMI amount plus bonus month(s) as per your plan — transparent terms explained at enrollment.

items.question: What is the minimum monthly installment?
items.answer: The minimum monthly amount is ₹2,000. You can choose a higher installment based on the plan and your comfort.

items.question: How do bonus months work?
items.answer: Each plan includes bonus month(s) (for example 11+1 or 18+2). After you successfully complete the full tenure with on-time payments, your return follows the scheme formula: total return equals (months paid + bonus months) × monthly amount. Use the calculator on this page to estimate.

items.question: Where can I enroll or get help?
items.answer: You can visit Pradeep Jewellers in Nadiad during store hours, call us, or submit the enquiry form — our team will guide you through enrollment and documentation.
